name: Zagarolo (Italy)
description: Maroon field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Zagarolo (three yellow hillocks on blue with S.P.Q.G.) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Zagarolo, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Zagarolo arms — three yellow hillocks on blue with S.P.Q.G., crowned, within branches
